summary: Learn to measure DEI indicators, assess workforce data, and build credible reports. Explore the five-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: DEI progress measurement and reporting helps HR, DEI, people-analytics professionals, and people managers assess workforce outcomes and communicate findings responsibly. Participants develop a baseline, define representation, hiring, and advancement indicators, check data quality, and interpret employee-experience evidence with privacy and measurement limits in view. They also practise dashboard design and concise reporting, drawing on Excel and Power BI concepts and references including ISO 30415, GDEIB, and GRI 405.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, interpret, govern, or report workforce DEI evidence and need practical ways to connect measures with decisions.
modules: Hiring and Advancement Metrics with GDEIB
prerequisites: Working familiarity with HR, people analytics, organizational DEI activity, or workforce reporting is expected. You should be comfortable reviewing spreadsheet data; coding or programming is not required. Bring a laptop with Excel if available. Power BI is optional, and exercises can be completed as dashboard designs without a Power BI installation.
